banner.text: FICO · Software is not an offset · Debt is above 3× operating income

verdict.title: Software is not an offset. Debt is above 3× operating income
verdict.detail: These lines are the watch. A holding pill means that particular gate has not broken. It does not mean the mortgage toll is safe.

freshness.detail: Segment rows match 10-Q filed 2026-07-29 (period 2026-06-30). Automatic debt, cash, and revenue rows were read from the SEC companyfacts feed on this run.

trust: Debt, cash, revenue, operating income, buybacks, and interest refresh from the SEC companyfacts feed on the nightly dashboard build and again on Sunday. The Scores split, bureau share, margin, unit-price sentence, lenders, and the policy grid stay at the last filing a person read. None of these gates are in the base return.

rows.label: Only Classic FICO on the mortgage price grid
rows.display: One grid. Classic FICO and VantageScore are both allowed.
rows.note: The watch wanted Classic FICO alone. On September 28, 2026 the 20-point markdown on VantageScore came off, and both scores sit on one price grid. Classic FICO is still allowed, and still required when a loan is underwritten by hand.

rows.label: Software revenue growth
rows.note: Watch line is 8% a year, set here so a low-single-digit software result cannot be read as a replacement for Scores. Fiscal 2025 operating income in Software fell $9.8 million.

rows.label: Net debt / annualized operating income
rows.note: Net debt $5,333.9 million ($5,282.4 million plus $300.0 million minus $248.4 million) divided by $1,340.8 million of operating income stretched to a year. Not a company-reported EBITDA multiple.

rows.label: Large originators preferring VantageScore
rows.note: Rocket has named VantageScore preferred. United Wholesale has not. The count fails at 3.

rows.label: Bureau share of revenue
rows.note: 54% a year earlier and 51% for fiscal 2025. Holding means it has not crossed 70%. It is already the majority of revenue, and the same three firms own the rival score.

rows.label: Scores operating margin
rows.note: Last reported Scores margin. The June quarter does not restate it. Holding means it has not fallen through 80%.

rows.label: Mortgage origination score unit price
rows.note: The filing says the Scores increase was primarily a higher mortgage origination scores unit price. It does not give the price or the unit count. A blank here is not a pass.

rows.label: Long-term debt, excluding the portion due within a year
rows.note: SEC companyfacts, LongTermDebtNoncurrent.

rows.label: Long-term debt due within a year
rows.note: SEC companyfacts, LongTermDebtCurrent. Included in the net-debt figure.

rows.label: Cash
rows.note: SEC companyfacts, cash and cash equivalents.

rows.label: Operating income used for the multiple
rows.note: 272 days in the span. Stretched to a year this is $1,340.8 million. Basis: year-to-date.

rows.label: Revenue, latest quarter
rows.note: SEC companyfacts. Company total, not the Scores segment.

rows.label: Revenue, year to date
rows.note: SEC companyfacts. Span 272 days.

rows.label: Operating income, latest quarter
rows.note: SEC companyfacts. Company total, not the Scores segment.

rows.label: Stock repurchase payments, year to date
rows.note: SEC companyfacts. Span 272 days. This is cash spent, not a statement that the price was wise.

rows.label: Scores revenue, June quarter
rows.note: Up from $324 million. Management tied the business-to-business increase to a higher mortgage origination score unit price. The filing does not split mortgage origination scores out of that book.

rows.label: Scores revenue, nine months
rows.note: Already above the full prior year. Fiscal 2025 Scores were $1.17 billion.

rows.label: Business-to-business Scores, fiscal 2025
rows.note: 81% of Scores that year. This is the toll the mortgage grid can contest. Fiscal 2026 split is not in the June quarterly report.

rows.label: Direct-to-consumer Scores, fiscal 2025
rows.note: myFICO. The mortgage grid does not set this price.

rows.label: Software revenue, fiscal 2025
rows.note: Grew 3%. Software operating income fell $9.8 million. That is not an offset if Scores weaken.

rows.label: Interest expense, nine months
rows.note: SEC companyfacts year-to-date interest, same order of magnitude as the last human read. Up from $94 million. The quarterly report ties the increase to a higher average debt balance: notes issued in May 2025 and March 2026, and a term loan used to buy back stock.

rows.label: Rocket Mortgage
rows.note: Past the recheck window. Confirm this before trusting it. Rocket's figure, not ours: about $1,600 saved at closing for borrowers who saved money, after running both models on 1.4 million reports. One originator is not the industry.

rows.label: United Wholesale Mortgage
rows.display: About 25% of borrowers score better on VantageScore
rows.note: Past the recheck window. Confirm this before trusting it. They said that share might reach 40% by the end of September. That is not a statement that VantageScore is the preferred score.

rows.label: FHFA mortgage price grid
rows.display: One grid. Classic FICO and VantageScore 4.0 are both allowed.
rows.note: Past the recheck window. Confirm this before trusting it. On September 28, 2026 the 20-point markdown on VantageScore was removed. Classic FICO is still allowed. A borrower at 780 on either model can reach the same top band.

rows.label: Loans underwritten by hand
rows.note: Past the recheck window. Confirm this before trusting it. The grid change does not remove FICO from manual underwriting.

rows.label: FHA and FICO 10T
rows.note: Past the recheck window. Confirm this before trusting it. A statement of intent, not revenue. 10T is not approved for delivery to Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

rows.label: Equifax
rows.note: Read mortgage inquiries, any VantageScore disclosure, and mortgage-revenue growth the week Equifax reports. Do not infer those from Fair Isaac's filing.

rows.label: TransUnion
rows.note: Same three items, the week TransUnion reports.

rows.label: Experian
rows.note: Same three items, the week Experian reports.

rows.label: US mortgage origination volume
rows.note: Needed to separate a price cut from a smaller mortgage market. Not in the Fair Isaac filing.
